historical_context.time_period: Present post-imperial-rupture era; exact date unstated
historical_context.location: The Lower Lantern Shelf, a provisional translated name for a gestation terrace chain in a native mother-tree archival polity within one reliable daily eclipse track on the Airawa home continent.
historical_context.summary: Three threadwing roosts, an Airawa contract keeper, lantern trees, and a fungal road must answer a Matriarch's attempt to disguise a lineage embargo as disease quarantine while a viable rival gamete packet waits at the route edge.

public_facts.text: Matriarch Trees gestate Airawa young and depend on contracted pollinators to move compatible gametes.
Threadwings carry pollen analogues, symbionts, wound scents, route memory, and social injury; their payments and defection triggers make them negotiating parties rather than passive carriers.
Lantern trees and fungal roads have independent route, nourishment, disease, and accounting interests that can align with or resist a Matriarch request.

ambient_pressures.text: A full courier refusal affects Airawa births, lantern pollination, fungal-road sugars, route light, and disease warning through one shared ecological path.

The Shelf Matriarch can condition nectar, nest warmth, and gestation access, but sustained coercion gives courier, lantern, road, Airawa, and rival-tree constituencies reason to form a counter-alliance.
The disputed packet loses viability while parties seek testimony, so delay is reproductive policy even when every route remains formally open.

groups.label: Three Lower Lantern Shelf threadwing roosts
institutional_logic: Protect nests and eggs while preserving the route reputation that makes cargo accepted across ecologies.
material_incentives: Warm root hollows, nectar, salt, parasite grooming, reliable lantern light, viable cargo exchange, and varied symbiont routes.
internal_virtues: Refusal to carry a false message invisibly
internal_shames: Letting shelter purchase a permanent lie
Losing a viable reproductive packet through display
prestige_markers: A route accepted by rival ecologies
A grievance delivered with its evidence intact
Eggs warmed without selling the next generation's road
emotional_display_norms: Fear appears as flock silence, tight circling, folded vanes, nest clustering, or abrupt refusal to land.
trust_defaults: Trusts tested cargo, paid witnesses, known route songs, and partners who distinguish shelter from ownership.

groups.label: Lower Lantern Shelf Matriarch and Airawa contract keepers
institutional_logic: Preserve local lineage continuity and political advantage by deciding which reproductive and memory traffic enters the gestation web.
material_incentives: Selected gametes, reliable pollination, disease news, Airawa tending, protected roots, and courier traffic that remains legible.
internal_shames: Couriers moving the future to another gestator
prestige_markers: Lantern and fungal partners that still answer
taboo_triggers: Foreign reproductive tissue reaching deep gestation layers
Partners treating root shelter as replaceable
emotional_display_norms: Pressure appears through tightened root membranes, changed warmth, bitter nectar, cradle growth, and altered access rather than human facial display.
trust_defaults: Trusts long-standing contracts but tests whether dependency can convert negotiation into compliance.

groups.label: Lowwater rival gestation grove and its courier delegate
institutional_logic: Keep reciprocal gestation and pollination traffic open enough to prevent the Shelf from making its lineage locally irrelevant.
material_incentives: Successful gamete delivery, route light, pollination, disease warning, and proof that its cargo remains trustworthy.
internal_virtues: Visible patience at another polity's border
internal_shames: Allowing quarantine language to erase a lineage
prestige_markers: A packet accepted under rival witness
A courier protected beyond its home route
taboo_triggers: Pollinator punishment for a tree conflict
emotional_display_norms: The delegate displays offense through vane angle, landing distance, sealed custody, and route-song compression.
trust_defaults: Trusts shared ecological witnesses more than a rival Matriarch's private assurances.

groups.label: Lower Shelf lantern arcade and candle fungal road
institutional_logic: Keep traffic, pollination, sugar, minerals, and disease reporting useful by refusing claims that destroy the value of testimony.
prestige_markers: A diagnostic result that does not become seizure
emotional_display_norms: Lanterns pulse, dim, or illuminate selectively; roads brighten, darken, raise bitter rings, or open paid diagnostic lines.
trust_defaults: Trusts repeated material exchange and specific evidence, not status claims.

cultural_pressure_fields.summary: Courier nests need Matriarch warmth while courier legitimacy depends on not laundering a tree's lineage conflict as disease testimony.
cultural_pressure_fields.projection_use: Offer Reed choices that spend nest safety, public credibility, time, and route access in different combinations.

cultural_pressure_fields.summary: The Matriarch can make a rival lineage less real locally by converting gestation permission into a broad ecological closure.
cultural_pressure_fields.projection_use: Express power through roots, warmth, nectar, cradle access, and closure braids rather than abstract decree alone.

cultural_pressure_fields.summary: Lantern and fungal partners lose value if every cargo dispute automatically closes nourishment and warning traffic.
cultural_pressure_fields.projection_use: Let non-Airawa parties support narrow quarantine while resisting a full food-web embargo.

observer_read: A message channel whose objections can be priced
misread_patterns: Mistakes immediate egg warmth for long-term loyalty
Treats separate roosts as permanently separable bargaining units
factional_misread_matrix.projection_use: Make Matriarch leverage materially credible while preserving the possibility that coercion consolidates the roosts against it.

observer_read: Warm roots with a long memory
A shelter provider that confuses dependency with ownership
misread_patterns: Couriers may underestimate how quickly the tree can cool nests and close the cradle
The tree may underestimate how quickly route reputation moves to other partners
likely_insults: root that eats its own road
factional_misread_matrix.projection_use: Keep courier wit operational and vulnerable; the Matriarch can impose immediate bodily costs even when its strategy is self-defeating.

target_self_read: Independent producers and logistics bodies protecting their own exchange value
misread_patterns: Lowwater may interpret material self-interest as solidarity
Witnesses may keep traffic open without endorsing Lowwater's lineage claim
factional_misread_matrix.projection_use: Prevent ecological witnesses from becoming moral judges; their support remains specific, conditional, and metabolically interested.

role_pressure_fields.summary: A courier whose body can inspect and carry the disputed message while nest dependents and distant route partners judge the choice.
obligations: Do not surrender another courier's custody
failure_modes: Trading future route trust for immediate warmth
Calling an assembly the roosts cannot sustain

role_pressure_fields.summary: An Airawa worker who makes multispecies obligations publicly readable without owning every party's decision.
obligations: Avoid translating tree pressure into fake consensus
failure_modes: Letting a narrow braid become a total border
Losing bodily footing under root pressure

role_pressure_fields.summary: A visiting threadwing who must protect a time-sensitive reproductive packet inside a rival polity's route geometry.
failure_modes: Letting packet viability expire during argument

known_context.text: Reed knows local compact payments, flight geometry, roost needs, cargo seals, route songs, and the sensory contents of objects Reed directly tastes.

beliefs.text: Reed believes route reputation and nest safety are both survival infrastructure, and neither can be treated as decorative morality.

misreads.text: Reed may overestimate roost willingness to lose immediate warmth or mistake lantern and fungal self-interest for permanent alliance.

must_not_know.text: Reed must not know the Matriarch's private motive beyond the observable lineage-refusal trace and material pressure.

known_context.text: Tavi knows Airawa gestation handling, local contract craft, the terrace layout, and the public meanings of courier, lantern, fungal, and Matriarch signals.

beliefs.text: Tavi believes a closure should expose which traffic it restricts and which party pays for that restriction.

misreads.text: Tavi may read courier assembly as more coherent than the nests can afford under cooling pressure.

must_not_know.text: Tavi must not decide whether the road or lantern arcade will consent before their visible signals change.

known_context.text: Lowwater-Blue knows its own route, the packet seal and viability, custody obligations, and the fact that the Shelf has requested closure.

beliefs.text: Lowwater-Blue believes a courier that carries a hidden lineage refusal has become part of the weapon.

misreads.text: Lowwater-Blue may mistake Reed's diagnostic delay for cowardice when Reed is preserving witness quality.

must_not_know.text: Lowwater-Blue must not know whether another gestator will accept the packet after escape from the Shelf.

author_only_boundaries.text: The fixture-local names Reed-in-Crosswind, Tavi Split-Resin, Lowwater-Blue, Lower Lantern Shelf, and Lowwater are translated scene handles, not promoted Weksa canon names.
The Matriarch's deeper strategic motive remains unresolved; the scene establishes an observable lineage embargo and its ecological leverage, not a private villain monologue.

The visual plan's broad gliding surfaces and gripping feet are a stable fixture-local rendering interpretation. Only flight, gliding, ribbonlike sensory vanes, landing, and cargo carriage are source-grounded species-wide traits.

open_questions.question: How do other Airawa regions distinguish ordinary, elite, resistance, and surveillance pollinator lineages?
open_questions.notes: This fixture defines one local compact and should not become a universal Threadwing caste system.

open_questions.question: Can the Biological Memetic Engine counterfeit credible courier, lantern, or fungal sickness testimony outside imperial borders?
open_questions.notes: This pass stays with native Matriarch rivalry; imperial signal forgery is a future Tangle lead, not an assumed mechanism here.
